message: Real complete-game simulations audited against published final results. These are experimental, uncalibrated retrospective models. Original pregame publication, injury and lineup archives are incomplete; no validated model promotion or market advantage is claimed.

protocol.testRefitting: None. All parameters and roster features frozen before the final period.
protocol.evaluationOnlyFinals: Forecast compressed artifact is written before final-stat retrieval. Actuals never enter that forecast.
protocol.baseline: Prior recent team scoring/conceding averages; player prior-game means on matched observations. No historical lines fabricated.

limitations: Football development250 uses candidate15.0.0; later validation/test use candidate15.1.0. They must not be pooled as one model’s accuracy.
NBA15.0.0 initial development and15.1.1 revised development are reported separately. Repeated games do not increase the unique sample count.
All models are unpromoted candidates. Missing original availability timestamps, historical injury/lineup archives and source corrections prevent a strict prospective validation claim.
Frozen final-test rosters may become stale across weeks. This is intentionally conservative and not a claim of injury-adjusted live performance.
No verified historical contract thresholds/fees/settlement rules were available. Prop over/under win rates and market superiority are not graded.

Football special-teams scores, live-ball penalties, exact period-specific overtime and causal personnel/weather effects remain incomplete. NBA technical/bonus administration, team rebounds, causal rest/blowout and injury effects remain incomplete.
Monte Carlo Wilson intervals quantify sampling variation, not total model uncertainty. No raw hit rate is labeled calibrated.
